anomalies.description: A person is seen mid-air, seemingly thrown or leaping over a low wall/counter in a market stall area; another individual is partially visible behind the counter, suggesting a physical altercation initiated just before frame f0.
Two individuals are engaged in close physical contact near the doorway of a market stall; one appears to be pushing or grappling with the other, consistent with mutual combat.
A man in a black shirt and cap raises a handgun and appears to fire it; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the posture and weapon orientation strongly indicate an act of shooting.
